title: noise.duffing
description: `noise.duffing` generates values from a numerical solution of the Duffing attractor equations, providing the system’s dx and dy values through two outlets. Send it a bang—commonly from a `metro`—to output the next values; its optional creation arguments set a, b, w, and the time step dt, with defaults of 0.25, 0.3, 1.0, and 0.01.
